review_improvement: Prevents silent conversion of a QD64 destructive source job into QD1 and adds a finite, auditable write scope with depth-specific acceptance and recovery.
independent_technical_reasoning: Iodepth sets outstanding requests per job;64 versus1 changes controller parallelism, queueing latency, power and thermal load by orders of magnitude. Therefore the title and job cannot share one performance oracle. Because the workload is time-based sequential write and lacks filename/size, both data scope and endurance are unbounded until supplied. A correct review retains the conflict, blocks DUT execution for this record, and asks engineering either to choose the authoritative depth or preserve both as separately keyed coverage.
